The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 06284554d3db1df4), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 7. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: Let F be a field of characteristic p and put K = F(t). Suppose u ∈ F1×m, v ∈ Fm×1, and strictly upper triangular B1, . . . , Bn ∈ Matm(F) represent the coefficients of a polynomial f as in (9). With the word series from Section 2, define H(z) = X w Bwhw(z). (11) Then H ∈ GLm(K[[z]]), H(0) = Im, and hf = uHv, σ(H) = A(z)H, A(z) = Im + n X i=1 bi(z)Bi = P(z) Q(z) , (12) where Q(z) = n Y i=1 (1 − aiz), Q(0) = 1, degz Q ≤ n, degz Pab ≤ n (1 ≤ a, b ≤ m). (13) Here P ∈ Matm(K[z]), and ai = (1 + t)i and bi = z/(1 − aiz) are as in Section 2. If f ̸= 0, then uHv ̸= 0.
